notes: ENG-OPS-003 governance Gap #12 (attestation-tracked, NOT a Sprint_plan.csv row — like Gaps #1/#2/#5/#6/#7; no CSV flip). Root cause (spec-draft handoff from Gap #7): the E2E env started only the web server, never @intelliflow/api, and NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL was baked empty at web-build time, so browser + SSR tRPC calls 404'd to web-origin HTML ('Failed to parse URL from /api/trpc'). Fix (ADR-063 Option 3, prod-faithful): playwright.config.ts webServer -> array with an @intelliflow/api entry gated behind E2E_START_API=1 (health-gated on :4000/health) + reconciled the dead/wrong :300 runtime NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL (:3000 -> :4000 for SSR); e2e-full.yml bakes NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL into the web build, builds the API (recursive filter), sets E2E_START_API=1, and sets E2E_API_URL=:4000 so the direct-POST inbound-webhook spec reaches the API; preship-full-nightly.yml sets the same env. Gating keeps the backend-free per-PR smoke job (no DB) from booting an API. Behavioural run 30172223720 PROVES the harness: API listening on :4000, zero parse errors, signup/home green, inbound-webhook now reaches the endpoint (401 SEC-004 HMAC, not a parse error). The dominant failure mode is eliminated. Residual e2e-full red is three independent, out-of-scope concerns (fonts, flake, SEC-004 webhook signing) filed as follow-up task_42358454. No pre-ship bypass, no --no-verify, no destructive git; all DB/build steps run under Node 22 (host default node v25 hangs pg writes). Two out-of-scope Playwright consumers explicitly documented and left untouched: the per-PR smoke e2e job (ci.yml, backend-free by design) and test-regression.yml e2e-cross-browser (non-gating continue-on-error, entangled with the out-of-scope authenticated project).
